q.line: Doubled over with the hunger of lions
stanza: And then the slow lip of fire moves across the prairie with precision
While, somewhere, with your pliers and glue, you make your first incision
And in a moment of almost-unbearable vision
Doubled over with the hunger of lions
Hold me close, cooed the dove
Who was stuffed, now, with sawdust and diamonds

partner.line: Who was stuffed, now, with sawdust and diamonds

stanza: It is too short, the day we are born
Trying to serve with the heart of a child

partner.line: Trying to serve with the heart of a child

stanza: But you never let me go

q.line: I love my city they let me cut the line on the Dan Ryan
